briefdescription.para: Reacts to State ValueTree property changes on any registered terminal.

detaileddescription.para: Registered on each terminal's State ValueTree in setTerminalCallbacks(). Detects shellExited by checking for a PARAM node whose id property equals terminal::id::shellExited with value 1. Defers pane closure via callAsync to avoid destroying a component from within its own listener callback chain (the VT callback fires from flush() which fires from the timer-driven flush on the message thread).

briefdescription.para: Propagates visibility to child terminals.

detaileddescription.para: When Panes becomes visible, makes all terminals visible. When hidden, hides all terminals.

briefdescription.para: Converts a pixel rect into terminal cell dimensions.

detaileddescription.para: Pure math: subtracts terminal padding from the rect, divides by effective cell width/height. Resolves the typeface internally via jam::Typeface::findTypeface. Used by the restore walker to pre-compute per-pane dims and by splitActive for fresh splits.

parameterdescription.para: Target pixel rect for the pane (AFTER chrome subtracted).

simplesect.para: Pure math — no instance state. noexcept.

memberdef.name: splitRect

briefdescription.para: Splits a pixel rect by direction and ratio.

detaileddescription.para: Pure math: given a parent rect, a direction string ("vertical" or "horizontal" — matching PaneManager idDirection semantics), and a ratio in (0,1), returns the two child rects after the split. The first rect is the "target" (left/top), the second is the "new" (right/bottom). Uses jam::PaneManager::resizerBarSize as SSOT — matches layoutNode arithmetic exactly.

parameterdescription.para: Parent pixel rect.
"vertical" or "horizontal" (matches PaneManager idDirection).
Split ratio in (0,1).

simplesect.para: Pure math — no instance state. noexcept.
